The '''Toprawa system''', also known as the '''Toprawan system''',<ref name="RESB">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], it was declared a [[restricted system]]<ref name="sw1" /> during and after the [[Battle of Toprawa]].<ref name="Black Knight">{{SWRadio|Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns}}</ref>
